title: Milo Murphy’s Law
description: Milo Murphy is the personification of Murphy’s Law where anything that can go wrong will go wrong. Suffering from Extreme Hereditary Murphy’s Law condition (EHML), Milo always looks to make the best of the cards he’s been dealt and his endless optimism and enthusiasm can turn any catastrophe into a wild adventure. Together, he and his friends will learn that it’s all about a positive attitude and not to sweat the big stuff… and it’s all big stuff.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x1
episodes_data.description: Zack, the new kid in town, finds that even a simple trip to school becomes an adventure when he meets Milo Murphy.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x2
episodes_data.description: After science teacher Mrs. Murawski announces a science project, Milo, Zack, and Melissa must overcome Murphy's Law to protect an egg and their grades.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x3
episodes_data.description: Milo is allowed to attend his first school football game since the home team, The Geckos will lose anyway, but discovers a way he can help them win.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x4
episodes_data.description: While on the subway on a school field trip, Milo’s car gets thrown off course and he, Zack and Melissa discover an underground city of subterranean creatures.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x5
episodes_data.description: Sara wants to go see The Doctor Zone Files movie with Milo, but worries about potential problems.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x6
episodes_data.description: Milo and the gang spend the entire day chasing after his doctor’s note that excuses an entire semester of absences, illness and shenanigans caused by Murphy’s Law.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x7
episodes_data.description: The other school kids, led by Melissa and Zack, throw a surprise birthday party for Milo at a go-kart arena.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x8
episodes_data.description: Zack, Melissa, and Milo attend an opera performance with Amanda, but Milo accidentally ends up backstage and attempts to prevent any havoc from occurring.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x9
episodes_data.description: It's career day and Milo is having a hard time deciding what his career should be. He tries to decide while visiting the water works, fire department, and hospital. But of course, everything goes wrong. Meanwhile, Dakota and Cavendish try and make sure a truck full of pistachios makes it to the pistachio warehouse.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x10
episodes_data.description: Milo and his friends visit a dude ranch. While horse back riding, they meet a girl named Jackie who joins their posse, and Zack is smitten with love. But, Jackie leads them into more danger than usual. Meanwhile, Sara is going crazy because the ranch reminds her of scenes from The Doctor Zone Files, and invites other fans to join in the geek fest.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x11
episodes_data.description: When Milo accidentally joins another family on their vacation, the new family must learn to cope with Murphy’s Law.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x12
episodes_data.description: Milo and Zack try to help Melissa overcome her secret fear of roller coasters.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x13
episodes_data.description: Milo and Melissa share their most embarrassing stories, but Zack refuses to reveal his past.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x14
episodes_data.description: The gang participates in a school event that combines both the academic and athletic decathlon.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x15
episodes_data.description: A jaded science substitute teacher, Ms. Baxter, re-discovers her love of teaching after a life-altering day with Milo.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x16
episodes_data.description: Cavendish and Dakota compete against two of the agency’s top operatives, Brick and Savannah, to impress their boss.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x17
episodes_data.description: At a donation drive, Milo accidentally gives away his mother's vintage T-shirts. Meanwhile, Cavendish and Dakota are assigned to protect the pistachios at the zoo.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x18
episodes_data.description: Amanda is concerned that Milo will ruin everything at her carefully orchestrated school dance.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x19
episodes_data.description: Milo, Melissa, Zack, and Mort's band enters the battle of the bands, where Zack discovers his old boy band is competing.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x20
episodes_data.description: Milo, Zack and Melissa go to school after sunset to retrieve Melissa's math book. Unfortunately, she leaves the spare key inside the locked classroom, so the three go on a "quest" in search of the mysterious janitor, otherwise known as the "key-keeper".

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 1x21
episodes_data.description: When Melissa’s dad drives her and Milo into town on a decommissioned old fire engine, chaos ensues.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x1
episodes_data.description: Milo, Zack, and Melissa—with help from Phineas, Ferb, Candace, Buford, and Baljeet—help conquer Murphy's law to stop a swarm of Pistachions.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x2
episodes_data.description: In a similar vein as "Going the Extra Milo", Milo and Zack attempt to survive Murphy's Law while getting to school on a cold winter day while Bradley and Melissa bet on whether they'll make it on time again. Meanwhile, Cavendish and Dakota are forced to stand before the Time Council for their constant failures, resulting in their being fired and having their ability to time travel revoked.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x3
episodes_data.description: After Scott the Undergrounder and Mrs. Murawski appear to hit it off and set up a date, Milo and the gang attempt to help the former look more presentable and normal.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x4
episodes_data.description: Melissa and Zack become determined to get a good picture of Milo for school Picture Day after learning he's never had a good one due to Murphy's Law; but Chad misinterprets this as Milo being a vampire and recruits Mort to help him prove it. Meanwhile, Cavendish and Dakota get new jobs at P.I.G. (Paranormal Investigation Group) and try to capture a Yeti on camera to impress their new boss.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x5
episodes_data.description: Doofenshmirtz reminisces on an adventure he had with Diogee the previous summer after the canine got caught up in an Agent P style mission.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x6
episodes_data.description: Milo and his friends and family decide to finally attempt to finish a board game.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x7
episodes_data.description: Milo and Elliot are the pace car drivers for a charity race.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x8
episodes_data.description: Milo and Amanda get the chance to be on the latter's favorite TV show, Cake 'Splosion!, an extreme kids' cooking show.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x9
episodes_data.description: Hollywood is rebooting the first Krillhunter movie with all women, so Milo and the gang help Tobias Trollhammer audition as a woman. Meanwhile, Cavendish and Dakota try to catch an alien while picking up trash by the highway.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x10
episodes_data.description: Sara starts to go insane from Dr. Doofenshmirtz constantly invading her personal space, so he goes out with the rest of the Murphy family to try new things

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x11
episodes_data.description: Learning that the local skating rink is closing down, Milo convinces his parents to pursue their dream of winning a disco skating competition they were unable to finish years ago before that happens. Elsewhere, Cavendish and Dakota are assigned to pick up seemingly ordinary lawn gnomes from a little old lady.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x12
episodes_data.description: Milo and his friends try to save the old clock at City Hall that Melissa's great-grandmother designed. Meanwhile, Doof tries to help the city by removing sidewalk gum under Agent P's supervision.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x13
episodes_data.description: Amanda helps Milo, Zack, Melissa, and Mort prepare for an afternoon concert while aliens try to covertly study Milo. Elsewhere, Cavendish and Dakota find themselves losing time and not remembering why.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x14
episodes_data.description: Doof shadows Milo to see how he navigates around Murphy's Law. Meanwhile, Cavendish joins an extraterrestrial conspiracy support group.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x15
episodes_data.description: While Milo is sick, two shapeshifting aliens attempt to get a tissue sample. Meanwhile, under Monogram's orders, Agent P continues to keep Doof from doing harm while attempting to do good.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x16
episodes_data.description: When his Uncle Cornelius asks for help on his farm, Zack seeks out to prove to a doubtful Milo and Melissa that a "city boy" like him can handle the job. Meanwhile, on a nearby farm, Cavendish and Dakota are assigned to pick up a fallen UFO piece from a farmer who wants to become famous in the tabloids.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x17
episodes_data.description: While heading to a mentor program she doesn't want to be a part of, Melissa ends up paired with Savannah on a mission to stop a rampaging robot that Milo and Zack accidentally built at the science fair before it destroys half of Danville.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x18
episodes_data.description: Elliott gets hurt because of a Murphy's Law related incident, so Milo helps him with his second job as a dog walker. Meanwhile, Cavendish and Dakota discover an alien anti-gravity device and try to show it to Mr. Block for a promotion.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x19
episodes_data.description: After discovering a boombox in the attic, Milo, Martin, and Grandpa Murphy go camping so Milo can undergo a family rite of passage to become a "Murphy Man". While the men are away, the Murphy women and Doof go to an art museum to celebrate the day without Murphy's Law, but Doof causes chaos in its place.

episodes_data.title: Milo Murphy’s Law 2x20
episodes_data.description: After an incident with a skydiving simulator, Milo, Melissa, and Zack are left in a cycle of falling and rising through the sky while Diogee tries to save them. Meanwhile, Cavendish and Dakota, while flying a plane and trailing a "Don't Litter Our Planet" banner, accidentally gain rivals in the form of Colonel Niblet and Lieutenant Tenant after taking the blame for Milo and his friends destroying one of their facilities.
